verdict.rationale: Jitsu's own blog post claims 'a full OpenAPI 3.0 reference at docs.jitsu.com/api' for its Management API [jitsu-docs-47], and it also documents a machine-readable HTTP API [jitsu-docs-61]. However, a direct probe for standard OpenAPI spec paths (including /api/openapi.json) returned 404 on all candidates [jitsu-probe-2], meaning the claimed spec could not be located/downloaded at the expected machine-readable endpoint. Missing for 10: a verifiable, fetchable OpenAPI/JSON file at the documented location, and independent confirmation the spec is actually accessible as claimed.
